attributes.action: Require citizenship for voting in Scottish Parliament and local elections
attributes.additional_details:
The 2020 Scottish Act lets all legally resident foreign nationals (including temporary visa holders) vote in Scottish Parliament and local elections from age 16. This is wider than the UK Parliament franchise. 

We ask the UK Government to introduce legislation restoring a citizenship based franchise, using Parliament’s residual power to legislate on any matter.
attributes.background: Introduce legislation so that only British citizens, Irish citizens and qualifying Commonwealth citizens can vote in elections to the Scottish Parliament and Scottish local government elections.

rejection.details:
Your petition is about something that the Scottish Government and Scottish Parliament is responsible for. That means that the UK Government and Parliament can't look into it. 

The Scottish Parliament has its own Public Petitions Committee. If you'd like to send your petition to the Scottish Parliament, you can find out more here: https://petitions.parliament.scot/

You may also wish to contact your local council and MSP who represent you about this issue.
